data.title: Palace Residences Creek Blue
data.about:
Palace Residences Creek Blue is a collection of elegant and stylish apartments nestled in Dubai Creek Harbour, one of Dubai's most sought-after neighborhoods. The 1 to 3-bedroom units in the 50-story tower boast stunning views of the creek and boast a thoughtfully designed architectural style. It is a project by Emaar that offers a lifestyle that truly exemplifies the distinguished style of the prestigious Palace Hotel brand.

Residents can enjoy an active lifestyle with sports courts, a skate park, a cycling track, kids play areas and a scenic waterfront promenade nearby. Emaar Palace Residences Creek Blue at DCH has an amenities podium featuring a gym, swimming pool, and wellness spaces. Palace Residences Creek Blue is also well-connected to the RTA ferry terminal and metro station, ensuring seamless mobility.

location_tile.title: A Community that Boasts a Sustainable Suburban Environment.
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Dubai Creek Harbour is an ultra-modern neighborhood that seamlessly integrates with the historic Dubai Creek. The pedestrian-friendly community features 500,000 square meters dedicated to parks and open spaces. Moreover, the community fosters a sense of belonging among its residents, with numerous social and cultural events that bring people together.

  • 5 Minutes to Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary
  • 10 Minutes to Dubai International Airport
  • 15 Minutes to Burj Khalifa
  • 15 Minutes to Downtown Dubai
  • 25 Minutes to Dubai Marina
